requirementSections.heading: Supplemental Courses

rules.commentRaw: Select any combination of six (6) credits from the School of Hospitality Management and/or the Recreation, Park, and Tourism Management approved MEMC courses on each academic unit's website. Students may select a combination of SHM and RPTM courses, or all SHM or all RPTM.
